name: Piper
tagline: A fast, local neural text to speech system that sounds great and is optimized for the Raspberry Pi 4. This container provides a Wyoming protocol server for Piper.
description: Piper is a fast, local neural text to speech system that sounds great and is optimized for the Raspberry Pi 4. This container provides a Wyoming protocol server for Piper.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/piper:2.5.2@sha256:26fc4838f1d693c21e24b011163555b86d2ec0d162d31efed8366501fcf86544
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      PIPER_VOICE: ''
      LOCAL_ONLY: ''
      PIPER_LENGTH: ''
      PIPER_NOISE: ''
      PIPER_NOISEW: ''
      PIPER_SPEAKER: ''
      NO_STREAMING: ''
    ports:
      - target: 10200
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
